summary: Mrs. Tokayer discusses how families can make the best use of their time together during vacations. She provides suggestions on using technology, taking pictures, and setting expectations for teenagers to ensure a quality experience.

How can I set clear expectations for my children during a trip?
What is a good way to help my child leave an uncomfortable situation?
